body:
First real slice of the widget system founder asked for ('start building out a ui widget system or something for reusable ui elements'), chosen via AskUserQuestion as the next deferred architectural thread after the v0.77.0-v0.80.0 close-out (over file-tree+tabs and the self-hosted live-recompile bundle). Deliberately scoped to ONE real widget type -- Toggle -- rather than a speculative button/slider/checkbox catalog nothing calls yet, matching this stdlib's own established 'expand the API only when a real feature needs it' discipline. New stdlib/editor/widget.prn: defstruct Toggle (x,y,w,h,label-on,label-off,on) + new-toggle/toggle-hit?/toggle-on?/toggle-flip/toggle-label/render-toggle, functional-update flip (no struct mutation) matching Buffer's own insert/set-cursor shape. examples/editor_main.c's hand-rolled status-bar auto-indent control (previously a raw rect hit-test + bare int flip inline in main()) is now the widget's first real caller, proving the abstraction against an already-shipped, already-screenshot-verified UI element instead of a blind design. 20 new real assertions in tests/test_editor_widget.c (pure hit-test/flip logic + a real end-to-end render-toggle call under Xvfb, new make test-editor-widget target). Full local suite + bazel build/test + real mingw cross-compile all clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 platform jobs. PARENA commit 446171e, release v0.82.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.82.0: real UI widget system v0 -- Toggle type
